decisions.reason: As a valve-adjacent pipeline fitting for our existing water and wastewater customers, it builds directly on our established design, welding, testing, and application knowledge, so we can learn from use and improve it efficiently.

A generic public waste bin uses our coating and fabrication assets but lies furthest from our core pipeline know-how and customer problem-solving base, limiting our absorptive capacity to develop a strong advantage.

The waste-bin-with-ashtray line still leverages our metalworking and powder-coating capabilities and has some overlap with municipal buyers, so it remains plausible to retain while we test and adapt the range.

Standalone outdoor ashtrays share production processes with our business but have a weak link to our established infrastructure knowledge and offer limited learning-based differentiation, making discontinuation more likely.
